scope: Source, experiment configuration, agent services, training interfaces, numerical behavior and measured runtime. No claim of complete replacement or task-performance non-regression yet.

authors_owner.provenance: Author repository master resolved via git ls-remote on 2026-09-24; this is not asserted to be the paper's exact original run commit.

installed_base.classification: Third-party fork with local patches, not pristine author implementation.

source_findings.evidence: Pinned fork adds full-chat accumulation relative to the author collector; 259 changed lines in source diff. Author collector uses the environment manager's per-step observation prompt.
source_findings.impact: Changes history semantics and grows repeated prefill/DT/PPO input work. Effect on task score has not been measured.
source_findings.action: Replace duplicated fork collector behavior with the author owner; keep only the accepted DT token/event seam and demonstrated platform/transport fixes. Replacement not deployed yet.

source_findings.evidence: Fork changes include a medical task outside this experiment. Local full_chat_observations rendering overrides the author's memory prompts.
source_findings.action: Use author task renderers with the author collector; remove redundant full-history render patches together, not one side alone.

source_findings.component: verl, examples and the three task env_package directories
source_findings.evidence: git diff between author commit and pristine pinned fork is empty for these paths. This does not cover our installed local patches.
source_findings.action: Audit installed patches individually; do not replace verified official PPO, task dynamics or parsers merely because the enclosing repository was a fork.

source_findings.evidence: Historical pinned-owner parity and current source hash retained; author and pristine fork core_algos.py are identical.
source_findings.action: Preserve official clipped objective and accepted DT advantages. No value model, second GAE, token baseline sampling or replacement PPO.

source_findings.evidence: 13 distinct tokenizer/collector/manager/RPC boundary cases passed across focused runs. These use real owner methods and Qwen tokenizer with explicitly mocked model/environment RPCs, not task-performance evaluation.
source_findings.action: Candidate is not deployed; rebase the needed stop boundary onto the selected official owner. No fabricated terminal reward.

settings_findings.gap: History/response differences change compute and task behavior; prior 32k capacity receipt does not validate this setting.
Current text task cannot be labelled a reproduction of the paper's visual score. Author script now independently verified, not just fork script.

The official verl-agent AppWorld worker and official LOOP experiment are different configurations. Matching 200x240 alone is not alignment with LOOP. Fixed PLAN currently specifies official verl-agent 10/0 rewards; do not silently change the reward alphabet or method.

runtime_findings.probe_configuration: Original actor and sleeping vLLM; B4, 512 synthetic response tokens; config cap remains 32768. Synthetic cost fixture, not task-performance evaluation.
runtime_findings.compile: First 2048 call 47.540s with 7 graph/cache loads; repeat and both 8192 calls had no new Dynamo/Inductor counters.
runtime_findings.interpretation: No repeated shape compilation in this bounded probe. Repeated prefix and per-event native/finite work are measured costs; task-scale savings still require aligned-owner comparison. Do not call all rollout time generation or decode.

remaining_evidence: Actual installed import graph and local modifications classified against author sources.
Remove redundant runtime implementations and compare official task reset, action parsing, observations, rewards and termination on identical traces.
Matched small-scale model/task evaluation and phase timing before claiming task performance preserved or restarting formal budgets.
